mapper.select: SELECT test_mng_no , t.homework_no , t.test_no , h.homework_title , (select count(t.homework_no) from test t where t.homework_no=h.homework_no) as problem_count , h.homework_rdate , h.homework_ddate , FIND_CODENAME((select answer_state from submit_test where homework_no=h.homework_no)) as answer_state , (select total_score from submit_test where homework_no=h.homework_no) as total_score FROM test t join homework h on (t.homework_no=h.homework_no) ORDER BY test_mng_no DESC
SELECT test_no , homework_no , test_mng_no FROM test WHERE homework_no = #{homeworkNo}
SELECT t.test_no , b.test_detail , b.test_score FROM test t JOIN test_bank b ON(t.test_no = b.test_no) WHERE t.test_no = #{testNo}
